title: Effective relative cycles are equidimensional
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: 7 行陈述（6 行证明）、有效相对循环等维：支撑闭（已收卡 0H5W）+ 纤维支撑定义性等式（支撑=∪Supp(α_s)，不同纤维互斥）+ 维数 r 定义收。1 处引用具名，无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-effective-equidimensional (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1979-1985

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Effectiveness makes the support closed by the effective-support lemma; the support is by definition the union over s of the supports of the fibre cycles, whose fibres are therefore the supports of the cycles alpha_s, each of dimension r as a cycle on the fibre; taking the closed support itself as the witness W gives relative dimension r, hence equidimensionality (source lines 1987-1992)
